description: Build an all-device hybrid n=32 solver on the stress-clean three-size branch: run the fused Householder/tridiagonal kernel on ordinary spectra, classify unsafe degeneracy and scale cases in-CTA, and route only flagged matrices or eigenspaces through scale-normalized cyclic Jacobi refinement without host synchronization, preserving n=176/n=352 guards and selective certificates.

Restored the 64.6 us fused n32 Householder solver and added a device-only residual/orthogonality/scale classifier with exact diagonal output and power-of-two-normalized selective cyclic refinement. Build failed because the generated insertion retained one literal patch marker before the fused kernel declaration.

Built a two-kernel all-device n32 hybrid: fused Householder/tridiagonal EVD first, then one selective CTA computes exact FP32 eigen/orthogonality residuals, handles exact diagonal matrices directly, returns for safe matrices, and runs power-of-two-normalized 195-round cyclic Jacobi only for unsafe matrices. All 39 official tests and 17 n32 spectral/scale stress families pass; n32 is 70.842 us and full geomean is 42012.058 us.

Removed the selector's full Q^TQ Gram pass and classified with exact AQ-QL residuals plus eigenvalue gaps, scale, and diagonal structure. All 39 official tests and 17 n32 stress families still pass. N32 is statistically unchanged at 70.818 us; full geomean measured 42041.108 us versus 42012.058 us before, with unrelated large-size variance.

Replaced the full fused-result residual scan with a direct all-device classifier for exact diagonal structure, nonfinite/unsorted/tiny-gap spectra, and extreme input scale; flagged matrices still use power-of-two-normalized cyclic Jacobi. All 39 official tests and 17 n32 stress families pass. N32 improves from 70.818 to 68.681 us and full geomean to 41938.969 us.

Reduced fused Householder launch from 512 to 256 threads so no threads exit before the eigensolve, following NCU's 40% barrier-stall signal. All official and 17 stress families pass, but lower Householder row parallelism raises n32 from 68.681 to 70.964 us; full geomean is 41999.550 us.

Restored the faster 512-thread fused launch and replaced its per-column full-CTA Householder tail-norm reduction with a single-warp shuffle reduction, removing one block barrier from each of 30 columns. All 39 official tests and 17 n32 stress families pass. N32 improves from 68.681 to 66.752 us and full geomean to 41863.576 us.

Replaced the second block barrier in each Householder v^TAv correction with per-warp reconstruction from shared warp partials. All official and 17 stress families pass, but serially summing 16 partials in every warp leader raises n32 from 66.752 to 68.818 us; full geomean is 41921.383 us.

Parallelized the one-barrier correction's 16 shared partial loads across every warp instead of serializing them in each leader. Official and 17 stress families pass. N32 recovers from 68.818 to 66.745 us, statistically tied with the simpler two-barrier 66.752 us; full geomean is 41882.969 us.

Reduced the fused n32 tridiagonal solve from 18 to 16 Sturm bisections and from three to two inverse iterations. Build succeeded, but official n32 validation failed orthogonality with residual 0.0197 versus allowed 0.000381; no benchmark was run.

Kept three inverse iterations and reduced only Sturm bisection from 18 to 16 steps. Build succeeded, but official n32 orthogonality residual was 0.000773 versus allowed 0.000381; no benchmark was run.

Reduced only Sturm bisection from 18 to 17 steps. All 39 official tests pass, but extended n32 stress fails the cond=4 planted spectrum orthogonality check at residual 0.00358 versus allowed 0.000381; no benchmark was run.

Combined 17 Sturm steps with a wider 1024-eps gap classifier. Official tests and all 17 stress families pass, but the active n32 benchmark correctness check fails one matrix at orthogonality residual 0.000485 versus allowed 0.000381, so no metric was emitted.

Combined 17 bisections with a 32-eps maximum adjacent-eigenvector overlap guard. All official and 17 stress families pass, but the guard routes nearly the full benchmark batch through Jacobi: n32 rises to 130.113 us and full geomean to 43996.431 us.

Changed the 17-step adjacent-overlap guard to sum all neighboring column overlaps and compare against one quarter of the checker orthogonality budget. Official and 17 stress families pass; selective Jacobi drops n32 from 130.113 to 75.417 us, but remains slower than the 18-step 66.752 us path. Full geomean is 42230.081 us.

For 17-step fused results that exceed one quarter of the orthogonality budget, applied an in-CTA Newton-Schulz polar correction and recomputed Rayleigh quotients; gap, scale, and nonfinite hazards still use cyclic Jacobi. Official and 17 stress families pass. N32 improves from guarded-Jacobi 75.417 to 68.233 us; full geomean is 41907.722 us.

Removed AQ and Rayleigh recomputation from the selective Newton-Schulz repair, retaining the already sorted 17-step fused eigenvalues. All 39 official tests and 17 n32 stress families pass. N32 improves from 68.233 to 68.023 us; full geomean measures 41863.488 us, statistically tied with the simpler 18-step 41863.576 us result.

Worked 16 trials from d39aecf. The all-device hybrid restores fused n32 Householder/tridiagonal EVD, classifies exact diagonals, nonfinite/tiny-gap spectra and extreme scale in the follow-on CTA, and runs power-of-two-normalized 195-round cyclic Jacobi only for hard-unsafe matrices; all 39 official tests plus 17 n32 spectral/scale families pass. The strongest simple point is 2c7cdb4ed4dd0c42fb01336cb7139235e7553f2a at 41863.576 us and n32=66.752 us: a warp-only Householder norm removes one CTA barrier from each of 30 columns; its profile is 59.719 us fused plus 1.999 us selector. Final ec1789a7e7b3f6c7c5e30a983dac449f52008e6a uses 17 bisections plus selective in-CTA Newton-Schulz repair, measures 41863.488 us and n32=68.023 us, and profiles at 58.671 us fused plus 4.809 us selector; the 0.088 us aggregate edge is far below noise, while the simple point is 1.271 us faster at n32. Built negative points include a 256-thread launch (70.964 us), one-barrier correction variants (68.818/66.745 us), 16-step official orthogonality failures, and 17-step unguarded stress/benchmark failures; adjacent-overlap Jacobi guards cost 75.417-130.113 us. Please keep the tree moving: open directions are moving the adjacent/gap classifier into the fused CTA to eliminate the 2-5 us selector work, repairing only the flagged eigenspace rather than a full matrix, reducing the remaining tau/v/update barriers, and using a multi-CTA or cluster decomposition to address the 20-block grid underutilization NCU reported.
